mapper.update: UPDATE author_user u JOIN ( SELECT author_id, COUNT (CASE WHEN win_result = 0 AND status = 1 AND publish_time < NOW() AND order_deadline > NOW() THEN 1 END) AS on_sale_cnt, COUNT (*) AS total_cnt FROM author_article WHERE author_id = #{authorId} and deleted = 0 GROUP BY author_id ) a ON u.id = a.author_id SET u.on_sale_num = a.on_sale_cnt, u.total_articles = a.total_cnt WHERE u.id = #{authorId}
UPDATE author_user SET hit_rate = #{hitRate}, recent_articles = #{recentArticles}, recent_hits = #{recentHits}, consecutive_hits = #{consecutiveHits}, rtp= #{rtp} WHERE id = #{id}
